 # two-parameter filter
 {"name":"f2","params":[["x","B"],["y","AliasB"]],"result":["o","Bool"],

 # null-requires filter with its own pipe

 {"name":"deep","params":[["w","B"]],"result":["o","Bool"],

 {"name":"e","params":[["a","B"],["b","B"],["c","B"]],"result":["r","Bool"],"requires":None},

       {"target":"e","filter":"deep","bind":{"w":"b"}}]           # diamond: deep twice
